tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: You've spelt 'receive' wrongly again.
Y: Sorry, I wasn't ______ attention.

X: There's only one swing and there are two of them.
Y: Then they'll have to ______ turns.

X: Could you ______ me a favour and post this letter?
Y: Of course, I'm going past the postbox anyway.

X: Nobody has told Grandma about the accident yet.
Y: I'll ______ the news to her gently this evening.

X: Are you sure you can say nothing about this?
Y: Don't worry, I can ______ a secret.

X: Have you chosen which school to apply to?
Y: Not yet, but I have to ______ a decision by Friday.
